check_evidence.description: remora-federation-evidence-v1: base64 canonical REMORA federation action envelope (remora-federation-action-v1) with an Ed25519 signature in REMORA/FEDERATION-ACTION/v1

claims.establishes: The submitted REMORA evidence carries a valid Ed25519 signature in REMORA/FEDERATION-ACTION/v1 under a public key the customer pinned.
limits: Says nothing about whether the authorization was semantically correct
Does not establish execution, an effect or complete mediation
Trusts the pinned key; revocation of that key is not checked

claims.establishes: The signed REMORA authorization names this workflow, operation id, tenant label, approval id and action, compared as the values federation-port/v0 carries.
limits: Narrower than REMORA exact_call_binding-v1.1: arguments are compared as JavaScript values, so 1 and 1.0 are not distinguished
Does not establish principal binding; V0 carries no principal
The tenant is a caller-supplied label, not an authenticated tenant
A target inside the arguments is derived from the action, not independently authenticated

claims.establishes: The evaluation instant is at or before the valid_until REMORA signed, and that instant is reported as this component's admission deadline.
limits: Not fresh_authority_at_dispatch: revocation, policy and ToolSpec freshness and signing-key status are not evaluated
Uses the runtime's local clock; no trusted time

profiles.description: REMORA Federation Bridge evidence for federation-port/v0 (projection map remora-federation-port-v0)

keys.purpose: Verify REMORA/FEDERATION-ACTION/v1 signatures; the public key is pinned in the customer policy config as trusted_keys
keys.lifecycle: The private key stays with the REMORA deployment; rotate by pinning the new public key
